{{Quote|Are you sure Embra's really a Hutt?''"<br />"''I'd hate to imagine anything ''else'' can smell like that...|[[Jozzel Moffet]] and [[Farquil Ban'n]]|<ref name="UYV1" />}}
'''Embra''' was a compassionate [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who could often be found at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], with fellow Hutts [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] and [[Malta]]. He was known for wearing a [[Nose/Legends|nose]] ring through both nostrils. Embra based his operations on the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mazhar]].

==Biography==
Because of his kinder disposition that was not often seen in Hutts, he had a strong loyalty amongst his subjects. At some point before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Embra, along with Jabba and Malta, organized a hunt for the [[Yavin Vassilika]]. For his three contractors, Embra chose the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], and [[Sardu Sallowe]].<ref name="UYV1" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], after narrowly escaping a [[Death/Legends|death]] sentence by the invaders, Embra led a resistance group against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] known as the [[Sisar Runners]]. Near the end of the war, he aided the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TUF" />

{{RPGseed}}
During the Vong War, Embra had his headquarters on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. As punishment for the Hutts' betrayal, group of Vong warriors were sent to attack the resistance.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Embra appears in the comic book [[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'']], as well as the ''[[New Jedi Order]]'' series.

In the [[Wizards of the Coast]] article ''[[I, Yuuzhan Vong]]'', Embra is the subject of the Adventure Seed: For the Glory of Yun-Yuuzhan! where the players must attack the Hutt's secrect base.
